programme.title: The Assassination Of Jesse James By The Coward Robert Ford
programme.desc: International superstar Brad Pitt (Troy) stars as legendary outlaw Jesse James in this Western drama based on Ron Hansen's best-selling novel The Assassination Of Jesse James By The Coward Robert Ford. A charismatic, superstitious and moody man, Jesse James (Pitt) presides over a ragtag gang of outlaws who fear his quick temper and even quicker shooting ability. Young Robert Ford (Casey Affleck - Ocean's Twelve) worships Jesse and joins the James Gang, only to become resentful of his hero. Intent on taking Jesse's place, the young upstart hatches a plan to kill the fastest gun in the West. But after gunning Jesse James down, Robert Ford lives out the rest of his days tormented by the cold-blooded killing of his former mentor.

programme.title: War Dogs
programme.desc: The Wolf of Wall Street's Jonah Hill and Whiplash's Miles Teller star in this dramedy based on a true story that follows two twenty-something Miami stoners who exploit a little-known government initiative during the Iraq War that allows small businesses to bid on U.S. Military contracts. Starting small, they begin raking in big money and are soon living the high life. But the pair gets in over their heads when they land a $300 million deal to arm the Afghan Military -- a deal that puts them in business with some very shady people, not the least of which turns out to be the U.S. Government. Comedy powerhouse Todd Phillips (The Hangover films) writes, directs and produces (with Bradley Cooper) this incredible true story based on a controversial Rolling Stone article.

programme.desc: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path! // Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.122: Barbabright Has a Secret / Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.102: Lorelai's Bracelet / Cecelia And The Ghost Ship
programme.desc: Bonnie steals Lorelai's bracelet, turning herself into a mermaid and while trapping Lorelai in human form! // Santi and crew must overcome ghostly shenanigans to save Cecilia from the dreaded Ghost Ship

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.103: To The Lighthouse / The Golden Giant
programme.desc: When a storm blows out the lighthouse light, Santi and crew hurry to guide Mami and Abuelo back from sea. // When Enrique awakens a giant, Santi and crew must find a way to save the day.

programme.title: Deer Squad S2 Ep.204: Raining Teddies / Party People
programme.desc: Jade's first sleepover is an eventful occasion when Stu & Safia make it rain teddies across the city and Central Forest! // Sir Steel is put out when he discovers he's not been invited to Lady Fluffpot's party but the Deer Squad are.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S2 Ep.201: The Spider's Stolen Silk / The Mystery in the Snow Maze
programme.desc: When an artistic spider's latest web masterpiece is stolen, Sam and Kit are called in to crack the case. // When a baby Arctic Fox goes missing, Sam and Kit are called in to investigate.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.238: The baby Piggy
programme.desc: Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloé and her new baby brother, Alexander. Baby Alexander is too little to play games, but Peppa and Chloé have a great idea;

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.239: Nature Trail
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are driving out to the countryside to go for a walk in the woods. Peppa and George discover trails of footprints left by little birds and ants.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.240: Pretend Friend
programme.desc: Suzy Sheep has made up a pretend friend called “Leo Lion”. Peppa cannot see Leo but Suzy says that Leo likes roaring and dressing up. Peppa decides that now she can see Leo. Even Mummy and Daddy Pig play along. But George feels a bit left out.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.241: Pen Pal
programme.desc: Peppa has a French pen pal, a girl donkey, named Delphine. They also speak to each other on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.242: Granny and Granpa's Attic
programme.desc: Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but it's hard to decide what to throw out. Amongst the clutter, Peppa finds an old record player and some funny old records.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.243: School Camp
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends are going camping with Madame Gazelle. When it gets dark, they all sing a song around the campfire. When it is time for bed, Peppa and her friends get a little scared and all the children end up sleeping in Madame Gazelle’s tent

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.244: The Toy Cupboard
programme.desc: Peppa and George's toy basket is full and their beds are covered in toys. Mummy Pig orders a new toy cupboard, but it needs to be assembled – and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not good at DIY.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.245: Captain Daddy Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig’s boat for a day on the river. Daddy Pig is the captain, Peppa, George and Mummy Pig are the crew. When the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig has to use all his strength to push the boat free.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.246: The Quarrel
programme.desc: Peppa and Suzy Sheep are having a quarrel and decide they are not best friends anymore. As time goes by they really miss each other but they still refuse to make up.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.248: Bouncy Ball
programme.desc: Peppa and George are playing in the garden with their bouncy ball when Suzy Sheep turns up with two tennis rackets. She uses the bouncy ball to play a game of tennis with Peppa, making George feel left out. Will the job of ball boy cheer him up?

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.249: The Powercut
programme.desc: One day all the lights suddenly go out and Peppa’s house is plunged into darkness. There has been a power cut. While they wait for the electricity to come on again, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play.

programme.title: DORA S3 Ep.305: Dora's Birthday Surprise / Moonlight Fiesta
programme.desc: Dora and Boots find Dora's lost birthday cake and the family throws her a surprise birthday party! // Dora and Boots help La Luna find the Luna Lily so everyone can enjoy the Moonlight Fiesta.

programme.title: DORA S1 Ep.120: If The Boot Fits / Piñata Party
programme.desc: Boots tries new wacky new boots that Tico invented. // The twins have their first piñata party, but no one can figure out how to open it.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.104: Tooth On The Loose / Scaredy Croc
programme.desc: When Mr. Crocodile loses a tooth, Daisy wants to make sure he gets a visit from the tooth fairy. // Mr. Crocodile, Daisy and their friends are scared to fetch Martin's gloves from his spooky shed.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.204: Dreams And Illusions / Dreaming Apprentices
programme.desc: While everyone sleeps peacefully, one may wonder what the Barbababies could be dreaming about. // To dream makes you grow... But what can Barbidur, Barbalala, Barbotine and Barbidou possibly dream of?

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.101: The Barbababies' Birthday
programme.desc: It's the Barbababies's birthday. They all want to do something different with Barbapapa!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.413: The Crew Builds A Sporting Goods Store / The Crew Plays Construction Vehicle Soccer
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew help Coach Karima and Shopkeeper Shelley team up to open Builder Cove's first ever sporting goods store. // The pups move a giant watermelon for Farmer Zoe. But when squirrels get in the way, Rubble & Crew have to play to save the day!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.218: The Crew Raises A Runway
programme.desc: When Buttons the deer needs to cross the Builder Cove airport's runway, Rubble & Crew know just what to build.

programme.title: Paw Patrol S12 Ep.1213: Pups Save the Hum-Sprayer / Pups Save the Hot Springs
programme.desc: When Rubble's cousin Mix comes to town to paint a mural, Humdinger steals the paint and careens through the countryside. // When Mayor Goodway and Mayor Humdinger show up at Jake's new Hot Springs for a soak, three mountain goats chase them away.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.301: Pups Save a Tightrope Walker
programme.desc: Francois Turbot is bravely walking a tightrope, but seagulls threaten to ruin his act. Time to call the PAW Patrol!

programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: Championnat Du Monde D'Endurance Wec 2026 Ep.7: 6 Hours of Fuji
programme.desc: After the United States, it's off to Japan for the highlights of the 6 Hours of Fuji.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: C'Est Qui Le Chef ?
programme.desc: Blacklisted following a media scandal, the vain Étienne Barbier, a television celebrity chef, is facing major financial difficulties. His brother finds him a job that soon proves challenging on a daily basis: working behind the scenes for Lila Debruyne, a renowned young food influencer who is opening her first restaurant.

programme.title: Habitants Du Nord Ep.2: Kilometer 0
programme.desc: Nadia and Vincent discover the paddle steamer graveyard, try a bit of gold mining and then go to pick up the vehicle that will be their home for a month. First stop: the monument to Joseph Henry.

programme.title: La Fabrique Du Mensonge - Brigitte Macron, L'Ombre De La Rumeur
programme.desc: Everyone has heard the rumour about Brigitte Macron: she is said to be a man, and even her own brother, Jean-Michel Trogneux. In just a few months, it has become one of the most widely shared conspiracy theories in France and beyond. How could such an implausible theory spread so massively?

programme.title: L'Impasse
programme.desc: Psychiatrist dedicated to her work, Estelle lives a quiet life. One day, Thomas, her childhood sweetheart, is hospitalised in her department after an attempted suicide. When he's accused of killing a doctor, Estelle's rival, the pair run away together. But will the ghosts of the past catch up with them?
